parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Node 1 is V-001, a three-phase FWKO: gas goes to fuel gas with excess to the burn pit, oil to the Heater-Treater, and water to water treatment. It was reviewed across all six source-study elements using the guidewords No/None, More, Less, Reverse, Another, Fire/Explosion and Error. Prioritisation is consequence-led. Four deviations are ranked High: overpressure (PV-101 failure, blocked outlets or fire, with the PSV-101 A/B basis unverified), fire/explosion, low-level gas blow-by into lower-pressure downstream units, and high-level liquid carryover into fuel gas and the burn pit. The high-level case is ranked on the SYS-05 gas routing and the absence of listed independent level trips, not on the salience of the training vignette. Start-up without bypass opening is the only source-supported human/procedural deviation. Corrosion/erosion, temperature, interface, flow, reverse-flow, shutdown and E-001 items complete the boundary coverage. Safeguard credit is provisional because only tag names are given. Key open points are the 60 psig/130 °F versus 125 psig/200 °F discrepancy, unlisted level and temperature alarms, the PSV basis, fluid corrosivity and E-001 service.

Vignette-specific consequences (e.g., generator damage at another installation) are not attributed to Node 1 and were not used for frequency or severity.

uncertainty_notes: SYS-03 gives nominal 60 psig/130 °F and also a '125 psig to 200 °F' operating-condition text. Whether these are design or operating values is unclear, so overpressure and temperature margins cannot be confirmed.

Safeguard functions are inferred from tag conventions (PV, PSV, SDV, LV, PIT, FIT, FAL). Service locations, setpoints, fail positions and trip logic are not provided, so all safeguard credit is provisional.
No level transmitters, level alarms or trips, temperature instruments, fire and gas detection or depressurisation devices are listed. These are treated as unverified rather than confirmed absent.
The packet does not state E-001 location, service or heating medium, the fuel-gas consumers, the burn-pit design, downstream design pressures, or whether liquid transfer is pressure-driven.
Fluid properties (corrosive species, solids, wax, emulsion or foaming tendency) are not characterised.
Only start-up without bypass opening is source-supported as a human/procedural item. Other human-error items are conditional HAZOP prompts, and no organizational facts were assumed.

The background vignette was treated as non-evidential. Prioritisation is consequence-led from packet routing and listed equipment. Risk classes are indicative because no likelihood data or matrix definitions are provided.
